About.title: About LinkID
About.whatIsP1: LinkID is a free, open-source link management platform built for developers and professionals. Instead of pasting long, forgettable URLs across every platform, you get one clean username and predictable links for every profile you own.
About.whatIsP2: Share {github} or {linkedin} — and anyone who clicks it lands exactly where you want them, every time.
About.f1: One username across GitHub, LinkedIn, LeetCode, YouTube, and more
About.f2: Auto platform detection — paste any URL and the platform is identified instantly
About.f3: Real-time dashboard with instant add, edit, and delete
About.f4: OAuth login via Google & GitHub, plus email/password auth
About.f6: Dark, light, and system theme support
About.openSourceP1: LinkID is built entirely in the open under the {license}. Contributions, bug reports, and feature requests are always welcome.
